annotation.title_en: ISO/WD 26058-1 - Safety requirements for industrial mobile robots — Part 1: Industrial mobile robots
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for ISO/WD 26058-1, a Type C safety standard under development by ISO/TC 299 for ground-travelling industrial mobile robots in restricted-access industrial environments. It lists scope exclusions (industrial trucks, exoskeletons, road vehicles, floor-cleaning robots) and uncovered hazards. Stage 20.60, with a Part 2 on integration planned.
key_provisions_or_claims: Type C safety standard for ground-travelling industrial mobile robots in industrial environments with restricted public access
Excludes industrial trucks under ISO 5053-1/ISO 3691-4, actively stability-controlled robots, exoskeletons, road vehicles and floor-cleaning robots
Does not cover extreme, explosive, nuclear or radiation hazards, or transport of persons
Part 2 will address integration of industrial mobile robot applications
Currently at stage 20.60 (close of comment period), Dec 2025
